Name: SapphicPrincessic's Cotton Candy Cel Sheep for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from SapphicPrincessic (and Cel previously) I've updated their Cotton Candy version of Cel's Sheep (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11042]here[/url]﻿) to work with SDV 1.6. Credit for the original mods go to SapphicPrincessic and Cel

Cotton Candy Cel Sheep come in four colors. They live in barns and produce candy wools that can be turned into candy cloths.

Enjoy!
